input.summary:
Glazing, doors, shutters (part 5) builds 288 of its writes: shutters, window boxes and the doors on the z12 and z21 faces; it is not yet finished. The 230 REFUSED writes are the window and door openings in the walls, which shell-west fills with air and so locks; I made no edits to parts/fittings.mjs because no change inside it can clear that lock.
OFF-PALETTE for this part is empty in parts-report.json, so nothing needed swapping. make.sh exits 0 and produces build.nbt (6236 cells), but the report still shows REFUSED 230.
The fix belongs in parts/shell-west.mjs (not mine to edit): house() and the holes list fill the opening cells with air, which the runParts lock records as owned; those cells must be left unwritten so this part can glaze them.
left: REFUSED 230 writes into earlier parts (still reported after ./make.sh). Every refused cell I checked (3,2,13; 3,3,13; 12,2,13; 7,2,13; 8,2,21; 40,2,13) is an opening that shell-west owns because it fills the hole with air (parts/shell-west.mjs house(): the holes fill, plus the window and door hole lists). runParts locks any cell an earlier part wrote, air included, so no write inside fittings.mjs can succeed. Needed in parts/shell-west.mjs (the shell owner's module): build the wall body around the hole cells instead of filling them and then carving air, so the openings are never written. plan.md's rule 'Wall builders leave every listed cell AIR' is what creates this conflict with the lock; the plan should say 'leave unwritten' instead.
OFF-PALETTE: none reported for this part (parts-report.json offPalette is empty), so nothing was swapped.
The 230 refused glass panes and doors mean the windows and front, side and back doors are still open holes in the built shell. Shutters, window boxes and the z12/z21 face doors are placed.

waste.what: Diagnosing REFUSED: I had to work out by hand which earlier part owned the refused cells, by dumping MCD_PARTS_CELLS and checking membership cell by cell.
waste.cost: 3 tool calls and one cell-set dump; parts-report.json keeps only the first 8 refused cells, so the other 222 were not checked individually.
waste.tool: runParts report should name the owning part for each refused cell (e.g. 'owned by shell west (plots 0-3), air fill of hole'), and keep all refused cells, or a count per owner, in parts-report.json.

waste.what: The plan's air-as-opening convention clashes with the runParts lock: shell builders write air into every opening, and the glazing part is then locked out of exactly those cells. Nothing in the kit flagged this before the build.
waste.cost: Glazing part fully blocked (230 of 230 opening writes refused); only found by running make.sh.
waste.tool: A kit check (mcd check or a plan lint) that flags a shell part writing air into cells that a later part's plan entry names as its own, or a build helper that reserves openings as 'unwritten, owned by a later part' rather than air.

companions.task: Glaze the 230 opening cells (window pairs, triples, sidelights, fanlight, vent) once the shell leaves them unwritten, using the same windowPair/windowTriple/pane placements.
Hang the doorSets (double and single doors, hinge sides) in the door openings the shell leaves open, and check the threshold against the deck level.

structured_output.summary:
Glazing, doors, shutters (part 5) builds 288 of its writes: shutters, window boxes and the doors on the z12 and z21 faces; it is not yet finished. The 230 REFUSED writes are the window and door openings in the walls, which shell-west fills with air and so locks; I made no edits to parts/fittings.mjs because no change inside it can clear that lock.
OFF-PALETTE for this part is empty in parts-report.json, so nothing needed swapping. make.sh exits 0 and produces build.nbt (6236 cells), but the report still shows REFUSED 230.
The fix belongs in parts/shell-west.mjs (not mine to edit): house() and the holes list fill the opening cells with air, which the runParts lock records as owned; those cells must be left unwritten so this part can glaze them.
left: REFUSED 230 writes into earlier parts (still reported after ./make.sh). Every refused cell I checked (3,2,13; 3,3,13; 12,2,13; 7,2,13; 8,2,21; 40,2,13) is an opening that shell-west owns because it fills the hole with air (parts/shell-west.mjs house(): the holes fill, plus the window and door hole lists). runParts locks any cell an earlier part wrote, air included, so no write inside fittings.mjs can succeed. Needed in parts/shell-west.mjs (the shell owner's module): build the wall body around the hole cells instead of filling them and then carving air, so the openings are never written. plan.md's rule 'Wall builders leave every listed cell AIR' is what creates this conflict with the lock; the plan should say 'leave unwritten' instead.
OFF-PALETTE: none reported for this part (parts-report.json offPalette is empty), so nothing was swapped.
The 230 refused glass panes and doors mean the windows and front, side and back doors are still open holes in the built shell. Shutters, window boxes and the z12/z21 face doors are placed.
